description: <<- counts a leading no-break space as one character of indentation
notes: The spec says <<- removes leading spaces without saying which characters count as spaces: Comments and Whitespace treats tabs as whitespace as well as U+0020, and Template Literals interprets space characters by Unicode's definition for strip markers, which includes U+00A0 NO-BREAK SPACE. hashicorp/hcl counts any leading Unicode whitespace as indentation (flushHeredocTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go uses unicode.IsSpace), so U+00A0 is one character and one character is removed from each line. If only U+0020 and tabs counted, the first line would have no indentation and nothing would be removed.
